body: Moved from docs/tasks/P3-one-server-and-install.md on 6 Nov 2026 (the task files hold the definition only; how far a task is lives on the board). **Status 2026-11-03.** The install script and the `encore` CLI are built and proved on bare VMs (`evidence/c01`, `c03`, `c06`). `encore.local` was replaced by the find-your-server design (ADR-R40, P2-19 slice C: "Servers on this Wi-Fi"); confirm with the owner when P2-19 lands.
